tasks.title: TaskSuggestion SQLAlchemy model + Alembic migration
tasks.description: Create TaskSuggestion model in backend/src/models.py (or a new file): id, project_id, title, description, task_type, priority (int), estimated_effort (str), reasoning, status (pending/approved/rejected/modified), created_at, updated_at. Add Pydantic schemas for request/response. Create Alembic migration. Write tests first.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: TaskSuggestion model defined. Alembic migration exists. Pydantic schemas cover creation, update, and response. Tests verify model CRUD with aiosqlite.

tasks.title: PlannerService core logic
tasks.description: Create backend/src/core/planner_service.py. PlannerService class: async generate_daily_plan(project_id: str) -> list[TaskSuggestion]. Uses KnowledgeProvider to get SOT/SOP context, then GatewayProvider to call LLM with structured prompt, parses response into TaskSuggestion objects. Store generated suggestions in DB. Write tests first with mocked providers.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: PlannerService generates task suggestions from LLM. Uses KnowledgeProvider for context and GatewayProvider for LLM. Tests verify generation flow with mocked providers.

tasks.title: Approval workflow API
tasks.description: Create backend/src/api/planner.py router: GET /api/v1/planner/suggestions (list pending), POST /api/v1/planner/suggestions/{id}/approve (convert to Task), POST /api/v1/planner/suggestions/{id}/reject (dismiss with reason), POST /api/v1/planner/suggestions/{id}/modify (edit then approve), POST /api/v1/planner/generate (trigger plan generation). Use FastAPI DI for providers. Write tests first.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All 5 endpoints work. Approved suggestions create real Tasks. Rejected suggestions store reason. Modified suggestions update fields then approve. Tests cover all endpoints and state transitions.

tasks.title: Morning briefing endpoint
tasks.description: Add GET /api/v1/planner/briefing endpoint. Returns today's suggestions, pending approvals, project status summary as structured JSON. Designed for Telegram bot consumption. Include: suggestions (list), pending_count, approved_today, total_tasks_active. Write tests first.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/planner/briefing returns structured JSON with all fields. Tests verify response format and data aggregation.

tasks.title: Register planner router + wire into app
tasks.description: Include the planner router in main.py. Ensure all planner endpoints are accessible. Add planner-related settings to config (cron schedule, max suggestions per day). Write integration tests.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Planner router is registered in the app. All endpoints are accessible. Settings are configurable via env vars. Integration tests pass.

tasks.title: Code review — fix all issues including minor ones
tasks.description: Review all changes. Verify: test coverage >= 80%, ruff check passes, no broken existing tests, TaskSuggestion and Task are separate models, approval is the bridge between them.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: ruff check passes. pytest coverage >= 80%. All existing and new tests pass.
